item: goal item 5 - S5 stress profile, 24-hour MIXED_24H
howTheEndWasConfirmed: The report appears and build/s5-stress-24h2.log opens exclusively, which the running profile prevents while it holds the file. Both held at 08:48:37.
archivedTo: docs/evidence/s5/s5-stress-24h-20261008/ - stress-report.json, header.json, 2187 sample files totalling 8.62 MB, and the 339.2 KB stress log
whatTheRunEstablishes: peakedHeapBytes is 8402050160, under the 8589934592 the JVM was given, so the run stayed inside an 8 GB heap for 24 hours across 4629095 chunks without a teardown failure. observedSeconds matches requestedSeconds exactly and durationMet is true, so the duration gate is satisfied rather than tolerated.

theLongHistoryBehindIt.firstAttempt: A 24-hour run died to the watchdog 14 minutes after the first refill, from an inFlightFutures leak that grew the heap to 8 GB and made a chunk-save tick take 60 seconds
theLongHistoryBehindIt.secondAttempt: A run was on course to end after about 4.5 hours because the finite position list drained and stop() fired
theLongHistoryBehindIt.thirdAttempt: A 30-second drain window judged a completed profile as failed
theLongHistoryBehindIt.fixes: Self-removing whenComplete on the in-flight futures, refilling the position list while the window remains, and deriving the drain window from the requested duration with 120 and 600 second bounds
theLongHistoryBehindIt.thisRun: 67 refills, zero ERROR, zero watchdog, zero OutOfMemory across the whole window
